product.name: Aurelio SmoothWave 3-in-1
product.description: The Aurelio SmoothWave 3-in-1 is a versatile hair styling tool that combines a ceramic straightener, a flat iron, and a curling wand in a single ergonomic unit. It features adjustable temperature settings ranging from 120°C to 230°C, a rapid heat‑up time of under 30 seconds, and an auto‑shutoff safety mechanism after 60 minutes of inactivity. The lightweight design, weighing 0.7 kg, includes a detachable cord and a built‑in travel lock. Ideal for fine, medium, or coarse hair, the SmoothWave delivers smooth, frizz‑free results while protecting the hair cuticle with its advanced ceramic coating. Its sleek midnight blue finish and intuitive controls make it a professional‑grade choice for everyday use.
